mapper.select: SELECT i.*, p.period, p.status AS payroll_status, e.emp_no, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS dept_name FROM hr_payroll_item i JOIN hr_payroll p ON p.id = i.payroll_id JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = i.employee_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = i.dept_id WHERE i.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PAID') ORDER BY p.period DESC

SELECT i.employee_id AS "employeeId", i.cum_taxable AS "cumTaxable", i.cum_tax AS "cumTax" FROM hr_payroll_item i JOIN hr_payroll p ON p.id = i.payroll_id WHERE i.employee_id IN #{id} AND p.period >= #{yearStart} AND p.period < #{period} AND p.period = (SELECT MAX(p2.period) FROM hr_payroll_item i2 JOIN hr_payroll p2 ON p2.id = i2.payroll_id WHERE i2.employee_id = i.employee_id AND p2.period >= #{yearStart} AND p2.period < #{period})
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO hr_payroll_item (payroll_id, employee_id, dept_id, should_days, month_days, absent_days, late_count, personal_hours, sick_hours, overtime_hours, base_salary, allowance, overtime_pay, piece_wage, perf_grade, perf_bonus, other_bonus, attendance_deduct, gross_pay, social_personal, housing_personal, special_deduct, income_tax, cum_taxable, cum_tax, other_deduct, net_pay, social_company, housing_company, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.payrollId}, #{i.employeeId}, #{i.deptId}, #{i.shouldDays}, #{i.monthDays}, #{i.absentDays}, #{i.lateCount}, #{i.personalHours}, #{i.sickHours}, #{i.overtimeHours}, #{i.baseSalary}, #{i.allowance}, #{i.overtimePay}, #{i.pieceWage}, #{i.perfGrade}, #{i.perfBonus}, #{i.otherBonus}, #{i.attendanceDeduct}, #{i.grossPay}, #{i.socialPersonal}, #{i.housingPersonal}, #{i.specialDeduct}, #{i.incomeTax}, #{i.cumTaxable}, #{i.cumTax}, #{i.otherDeduct}, #{i.netPay}, #{i.socialCompany}, #{i.housingCompany}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.dept_id AS "deptId", d.name AS "deptName", p.category AS "category", SUM(i.gross_pay + i.social_company + i.housing_company) AS "amount" FROM hr_payroll_item i LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = i.dept_id LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = i.employee_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE i.payroll_id = #{payrollId} GROUP BY i.dept_id, d.name, p.category
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(other_deduct), 0) FROM hr_payroll_item WHERE payroll_id = #{payrollId}

SELECT e.id AS "employeeId", SUM(r.piece_wage) AS "amount" FROM mes_report r JOIN hr_employee e ON e.user_id = r.operator_id WHERE r.piece_wage IS NOT NULL AND r.report_date >= #{begin} AND r.report_date <= #{end} GROUP BY e.id
